verdict.rationale: Relay shows a fast application review (1-2 business days per relay-docs-12) and easy setup of accounts, cards, and invoicing, suggesting quick onboarding, but there's no explicit evidence of an end-to-end 'week-long' onboarding timeline or migration process from another bank. missing for 10: documented full onboarding timeline/case study, evidence of migrating existing banking relationships/data within a week, independent confirmation of onboarding speed beyond application approval.
